notes.title: Dlc 1 The Upgrader arcade
notes.content: If you go to your right in the lobby you will find a mysterious machine. That machine will allow you to play arcade games in exchange for gold. If your skilled enough you can win gold.

notes.title: Monster Hunt
notes.content: Monster Hunt Dlc was intended for you to go to upon beating the main levels. includes a bunch of new weapons, crafting materials, new enemies. Go straight down in the lobby to find this area.
